Mission Bay Commons parcels P12, P13, P15
record.summary: The three westernmost parcels of Mission Bay Commons (P12, P13 and P15) host interim uses – Spark Social SF, Stagecoach Greens mini golf, Urban Sprouts community garden and soccer fields – which Rec and Park says were 'initially launched as interim uses'; a project fully funded through OCII will renovate them into a permanent park, with construction beginning late 2028 and opening early 2030 on Rec and Park's estimated schedule.

notes.accuracy_caveat: MEDIUM CONFIDENCE -- real, community-surveyed OSM polygon for the current interim installation (Parklab Gardens; the wider parcel also hosts Spark Social SF, Stagecoach Greens mini golf, Urban Sprouts community garden and an SFF soccer field per SF Rec & Park's own Future Parks Project page). Marked 'existing' rather than 'complete' because this is explicitly an interim use, not the plan's final build-out: OCII's Mission Bay Future Parks Project will redesign parcels P12/P13/P15 into a permanent, unified extension of the Commons (planning 2024-25, design mid-2026, construction targeted late 2028, public opening targeted early 2030). This feature traces OSM way 446183018 (leisure=park, name 'Parklab', about 14,665 sq m and roughly 420 m long), the whole Parklab park strip: it fully contains the separately mapped Parklab Gardens way (437595662, about 2,212 sq m) and the Spark Social SF way (437591532, about 1,519 sq m), so it is not only the Parklab Gardens sub-area.

facts.value: P12, P13 and P15 (Rec and Park); OCII's November 2024 update lists them within 'Mission Bay Commons (P11, P12, P13, P15, P16, P17)'. Which interim use sits on which parcel is not stated in the sources read

changes.text: The map notes said the shape traces only the Parklab Gardens sub-area; it is OpenStreetMap's whole 'Parklab' park strip (about 14,665 sq m), which contains both the Parklab Gardens and Spark Social SF areas, and it is tagged as a park, not a garden. The notes also said P15's concept matches Spark Social SF's use of that parcel; OCII's Nov 2024 CAC update puts Spark Social SF and the community garden on P13 and Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens on P15, and the Workshop 3 deck dates interim-use pilots to P13 (2016), P15 (2017) and P12 (2018). The claim that a design team was selected through an August 2025 RFQ now says what SF Rec & Park reports: an RFQ was released and a team was expected by mid-October. The 'early 2030' opening milestone is relabelled as a whole-project estimate, with a note that Workshop 3 shows an earlier construction window. The map notes carry a dated correction, and the shape's notes and source description were corrected.

Community Meeting #3 (Apr 29, 2025, 83 pages) has individually labeled concept-plan pages for P12, P13 and P15 (food trucks, outdoor dining and a pavilion on P15; soccer pitches and outdoor fitness on P12), plus an alternative option for P12. These are design-workshop concepts, not an adopted final plan: SF Rec & Park's Future Parks page later reported (August 2025) that a design-team RFQ had been released and a team was expected to be selected by mid-October; no selection is reported there.
